author: Diego Sandoval
title: Yilber Diaz being called up by Diamondbacks
desc: Yilber Diaz is being called up to the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Diaz will be making the jump to the MLB club in a corresponding move to Ryne Nelson hitting the shelf. In 32 innings of relief at the Triple-A level this season, Diaz has a 4.50 ERA and 43 strikeouts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ryne Nelson diagnosed with partially torn flexor
desc: Ryne Nelson was diagnosed with a partially torn flexor on Friday.
impact: Nelson will surely be heading to the injured list with this injury, but the exact timetable for return is currently unknown. Yilber Diaz is being called up to the MLB club in a corresponding move. Nelson has a 4.97 ERA and 62 strikeouts in 83 1/3 innings this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Justin Verlander (hamstring) scratched from Sunday, expected to miss weeks
desc: Justin Verlander has been scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday with a hamstring injury and is expected to miss weeks.
impact: Verlander suffered a left hamstring injury after throwing a bullpen on Wednesday, and the Tigers now expect him to be on the shelf for an extended period of time. The 43-year-old was expected to make his return from the 60-day injured list on Sunday, with his lone outing of the season coming on March 30th.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: PJ Poulin gets spot start Friday
desc: PJ Poulin will start Friday's game against the Rays after Cade Cavalli was scratched with an illness.
impact: Poulin is expected to be the opener of a bullpen game for the Nationals on Friday. Poulin has a 3.29 ERA and 18 strikeouts in 27 1/3 innings pitched at the MLB level this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Cade Cavalli (illness) scratched from Friday's start
desc: Cade Cavalli has been scratched from his scheduled start on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Cavalli is dealing with an illness, so PJ Poulin will start in his place on Friday. Poulin is expected to be the opener for a bullpen game for the Nationals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daulton Varsho (wrist) hits off pitching machine Friday
desc: Daulton Varsho hit off the pitching machine on Friday as he continues to progress.
impact: Varsho is eligible to be activated on Saturday. If he continues to feel well, he could return without needing a rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ernie Clement battling hip soreness
desc: Ernie Clement's battling some left hip soreness.
impact: Clement is getting the day off for Friday's series opener against the Cubs. He is day-to-day as of now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peter Strzelecki opts out of deal with Yankees
desc: Peter Strzelecki has opted out of his contract with the Yankees.
impact: Strzelecki will be free to sign with another team as he seeks a different opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendon Little recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays recalled LHP Brendon Little from Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Little returns for another stint in the majors. He should hold a middle-relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chad Dallas optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays optioned RHP Chad Dallas to Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Dallas did not make an appearance since being recalled earlier this week. Brendon Little was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Bieber (elbow) to throw bullpen Saturday
desc: Shane Bieber is scheduled to throw a bullpen on Saturday.
impact: Bieber re-joined the Blue Jays on Thursday. If all goes well with his bullpen, his next start should come back with Toronto.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronel Blanco (elbow) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Astros sent RHP Ronel Blanco on a rehab assignment to Rookie League-FCL.
impact: Blanco underwent an internal brace procedure last June. He will figure to require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyrone Taylor (hip) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Mets sent OF Tyrone Taylor on a rehab assignment to Double-A Binghamton.
impact: Taylor has been on the injured list since May 26. He could be activated by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Dean recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs recalled OF Justin Dean from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Dean is slashing .238/.369/.354 with three home runs and 14 steals in Triple-A this season. He'll add depth in the outfield for the Cubs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Bloss (elbow) throws 65 pitches in rehab start Thursday
desc: Jake Bloss threw 65 pitches over four innings for Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.
impact: Bloss allowed two runs on one hit with three strikeouts and two walks. It was his first rehab start in Triple-A and fifth rehab start overall.
